description: Fix immediate bugs and issues in recommendation agent system: test timeouts, duplicate imports, error handling gaps, and RLHF CLI argument propagation
steps: Investigate and fix test timeout in backend/tests/test_recommendation_agent_v2.py. Likely causes: unpatched external dependencies or infinite loops. Add proper mocking and timeouts.
Remove duplicate LLMAgent import in backend/app/agents/orchestrator.py (lines 8-9).
Improve error handling in RecommendationAgentV2._load_models(), _score_items(), and weather service calls. Ensure all exceptions are caught with proper fallbacks.
Fix RLHF training script CLI argument propagation: pass --min-pairs argument to build_preference_pairs() function.
Remove duplicate RLHF navigation entry in frontend App.tsx NAV_ITEMS array.
Add missing type hints to critical methods in recommendation_agent_v2.py.
Run verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_agent_v2.py -v --tb=short completes within 30 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: All tests in test_recommendation_agent_v2.py run to completion without timeout
RecommendationAgentV2 handles all error cases gracefully with fallbacks
RLHF training script correctly uses --min-pairs argument
Frontend builds without duplicate navigation items
All methods in recommendation_agent_v2.py have proper type hints
verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_agent_v2.py -v --tb=short (should complete in <30s)

cd backend && python -c "from app.agents.orchestrator import AgentOrchestrator; import inspect; src=inspect.getsource(AgentOrchestrator); assert src.count('from app.agents.llm_agent import LLMAgent') == 1, 'Duplicate import found'"

cd backend && python -c "import app.agents.recommendation_agent_v2; import inspect; methods=inspect.getmembers(app.agents.recommendation_agent_v2.RecommendationAgentV2, predicate=inspect.isfunction); for name,method in methods: if not name.startswith('_'): sig=inspect.signature(method); assert sig.return_annotation != inspect.Parameter.empty, f'Missing return type: {name}'"
